title: Salinity fundamentally reshapes crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios in a high-value agricultural landscape
title_zh: 盐度从根本上重塑高价值农业景观中的作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合
title_primary: 盐度从根本上重塑高价值农业景观中的作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合
title_secondary: Salinity fundamentally reshapes crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios in a high-value agricultural landscape
authors: Saul Ngarava, Daniel Magnone, Iain Gould, Eric Ruto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Salinity intrusion is an emerging threat in low‑lying regions as climate‑driven fluvial/tidal flooding intensifies. Yet its impacts remain poorly characterised due to focus on biophysical processes and limited understanding of how it affects agricultural productivity, profitability, and risk exposure. The study sought to quantify the impact of flood‑induced salinisation on crop productivity and profitability, assess how it alters risk-return relationships, and evaluate how this affects crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios. The study focused on Greater Lincolnshire, United Kingdom as a case, and used spatially explicit crop, land‑grade, and flood‑risk datasets integrated with enterprise‑level gross‑margin modelling, Monte‑Carlo simulation, and cross‑crop competitiveness analysis. Without flood-induced salinisation, profitability varies across crops, with margins from £ 1114/ha for beet and £ 825/ha for winter wheat to £ 255/ha for potatoes. Under the salinity scenario, all crops incur substantial losses from simulated yield declines. Potatoes show the greatest drop (–£1382/ha), followed by beet (–£442/ha) and cereals such as winter wheat (–£339/ha), spring wheat (–£273/ha), and spring barley (–£304/ha). Risk-return analysis reveals that salinity systematically collapses the profitability hierarchy across crops, compressing them into a uniformly low‑return, moderate‑risk zone and thereby eliminating the high‑value production opportunities that currently underpin regional agricultural competitiveness. Competitiveness shifts markedly, with potatoes most disadvantaged and barley relatively resilient, while portfolio optimisation indicates strong reallocation toward winter wheat. Overall, the scenario suggests that flood‑induced salinisation could become a transformative constraint without flood defences, underscoring the need for proactive mitigation policies, adaptive planning, and investment in salt‑tolerant crop options.
abstract_zh: 盐分入侵是低洼地区因气候驱动的河流/潮汐洪水加剧而出现的新威胁。然而，由于其影响主要聚焦于生物物理过程，且对农业生产力、盈利能力和风险暴露的影响理解有限，这些影响仍未得到充分刻画。本研究旨在量化洪水引发的盐渍化对作物生产力和盈利能力的影响，评估其如何改变风险-回报关系，并考察这对作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合的影响。研究以英国大林肯郡为案例，利用空间显式的作物、土地等级和洪水风险数据集，结合企业层面的毛利润建模、蒙特卡洛模拟和跨作物竞争力分析。在没有洪水引发的盐渍化情况下，不同作物的盈利能力各异，利润从甜菜的1114英镑/公顷和冬小麦的825英镑/公顷到马铃薯的255英镑/公顷不等。在盐渍化情景下，所有作物因模拟的产量下降而遭受重大损失。马铃薯降幅最大（–1382英镑/公顷），其次是甜菜（–442英镑/公顷）和谷物类作物如冬小麦（–339英镑/公顷）、春小麦（–273英镑/公顷）和春大麦（–304英镑/公顷）。风险-回报分析显示，盐渍化系统性地压缩了作物间的盈利层级，将其统一压缩至低回报、中等风险区域，从而消除了当前支撑区域农业竞争力的高价值生产机会。竞争力发生显著变化，马铃薯最受不利影响，而大麦相对具有韧性，同时组合优化表明向冬小麦的强烈重新配置。总体而言，该情景表明，在没有防洪设施的情况下，洪水引发的盐渍化可能成为变革性制约因素，凸显了采取主动缓解政策、适应性规划以及投资耐盐作物选项的必要性。

title: United States of U-Star
title_zh: U型星联合体
title_primary: U型星联合体
title_secondary: United States of U-Star
authors: Hie Joo Ahn, Jeremy Rudd
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper estimates state-level trend unemployment rates (trend U-star) based on the trend components of unemployment inflows and outflows across unemployment durations. The estimated trend U-stars, particularly the portions attributable to long-termunemployment, have levels and dynamics that vary substantially across states. Long-termunemployment makes a relatively small contribution to trend U-star in agricultural states, but takes a larger share for Rust Belt states and several states in the Sun Belt. While higher educational attainment and population aging put downward pressure on U-star, the effects of industrial structure and labor-market rigidities are mixed. Using the estimates of state-level trend U-star, we revisit previous work on state-level Phillips curves and find that the estimated slopes of forward-looking inflation equations are driven bymovements in trend U-star rather than by cyclical variation in the unemployment rate.
abstract_zh: 本文基于失业流入与流出的趋势成分，估算了各州层面的趋势性失业率（趋势U-star），并覆盖了不同失业持续时间。估算出的趋势U-star，尤其是归因于长期失业的部分，其水平和动态在各州间存在显著差异。在农业州，长期失业对趋势U-star的贡献相对较小，而在锈带州及阳光地带的部分州，其占比则更大。尽管更高的教育水平和人口老龄化对U-star产生下行压力，但产业结构与劳动力市场僵化的影响则呈现混合效应。利用各州趋势U-star的估算值，我们重新审视了先前关于州级菲利普斯曲线的研究，发现前瞻性通胀方程的估计斜率主要由趋势U-star的变动驱动，而非失业率的周期性波动。

title: Mapping Economic Opportunities in Global Clean Energy Supply Chains
title_zh: 全球清洁能源供应链中的经济机遇图谱
title_primary: 全球清洁能源供应链中的经济机遇图谱
title_secondary: Mapping Economic Opportunities in Global Clean Energy Supply Chains
authors: Yang Li, Ketan Ahuja, Karan Daryanani, Ricardo Hausmann, Muhammed A. Yıldırım
official: 官方在线 2026-05-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides a framework for context-aware industrial policy by applying economic complexity theory to a newly constructed dataset of twelve key clean energy supply chains (CESCs). We find that CESCs are diverse but highly interdependent; they are also growing faster and are more concentrated than other industries. CESCs exhibit substantial entry, exit and competitive churn, and countries are more likely to enter CESC industries that are related to their existing productive capabilities. We also explore changing global competitiveness and country positioning in these industries, and draw out implications of these patterns for industrial policymakers.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将经济复杂性理论应用于新构建的十二个关键清洁能源供应链（CESCs）数据集，为情境感知型产业政策提供了一个分析框架。我们发现，清洁能源供应链具有多样性但高度相互依赖；同时，它们比其他行业增长更快且更为集中。清洁能源供应链表现出显著的进入、退出和竞争更替现象，且各国更倾向于进入与其现有生产能力相关的清洁能源供应链行业。我们还探讨了这些行业中全球竞争力及国家定位的变化，并提炼出这些模式对产业政策制定者的启示。

title: DP15374 Gravity with Granularity
title_zh: 颗粒化引力
title_primary: 颗粒化引力
title_secondary: DP15374 Gravity with Granularity
authors: Holger Breinlich, Harald Fadinger, Volker Nocke, Nicolas Schutz
official: 官方在线 2020-10-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We demonstrate that the estimation of gravity equations of trade flows suffers from an omitted variable bias when firms are granular and behave oligopolistically. We show how to correct for this bias in the estimation of both firm- and industry-level gravity. Using French and Chinese export data, we find that the oligopoly bias leads to a substantial underestimation of the effects of distance on trade flows. In a calibrated version of the model, the welfare gains from a trade liberalization are found to be almost twice as large under oligopoly as under monopolistic competition.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，当企业具有颗粒性并表现出寡头垄断行为时，贸易流量的引力方程估计会遭受遗漏变量偏差。我们展示了如何在企业和行业层面的引力估计中纠正这一偏差。利用法国和中国的出口数据，我们发现寡头垄断偏差导致距离对贸易流量的影响被显著低估。在模型校准版本中，贸易自由化的福利收益在寡头垄断下几乎是垄断竞争下的两倍。

title: The Market for ESG Ratings
title_zh: ESG评级市场
title_primary: ESG评级市场
title_secondary: The Market for ESG Ratings
authors: EHSAN AZARMSA, JOEL SHAPIRO
official: 官方在线 2026-08-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present a model of competition between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) raters who acquire information about multiple unrelated categories and sell ratings. Raters specializing in different categories maximize the amount of information transmitted and surplus, and can be an equilibrium outcome. When investors place a high value on ESG performance across multiple categories, the unique equilibrium is for the raters to generalize—splitting their effort among the categories, resulting in less informative ratings. Greenwashing by firms can make generalization the only equilibrium. We also demonstrate that specialization maximizes ratings disagreement, and thus empirical measures of disagreement may be poor measures of surplus.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，探讨环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级机构之间的竞争，这些机构获取关于多个不相关类别的信息并出售评级。专注于不同类别的评级机构能最大化信息传递量和剩余价值，这可以成为均衡结果。当投资者高度重视跨多个类别的ESG表现时，唯一均衡是评级机构采取泛化策略——将努力分散到各个类别，导致评级信息含量降低。企业的漂绿行为可能使泛化成为唯一均衡。我们还证明，专业化能最大化评级分歧，因此实证中的分歧指标可能无法有效衡量剩余价值。

title: Government bond-backed repo markets: between resilience and vulnerability
title_zh: 政府债券回购市场：韧性与脆弱性之间
title_primary: 政府债券回购市场：韧性与脆弱性之间
title_secondary: Government bond-backed repo markets: between resilience and vulnerability
authors: Ayelen Banegas, Lucas Devigne, Mulalo Mamburu, Kleopatra Nikolaou, Anna Samarina 等
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper synthesizes the literature on vulnerabilities in government bond-backed repo markets, focusing on the features that contribute to both the fragility and stability of these markets. The literature shows that the same features that enable efficient liquidity provision, including short-term funding, dealer intermediation, extensive collateral reuse, and low haircuts, can also create channels for rapid transmission of stress. The review documents tight linkages between repo and government bond markets, highlighting how repos are key to the build-up of leverage and can propagate stress across funding, cash, and derivatives markets, particularly through dealers and nonbank financial intermediaries such as investment firms, hedge funds, and money market funds. Evidence from recent stress episodes illustrates how these vulnerabilities materialize in practice. The review also examines post-crisis regulatory reforms and central bank interventions, identifying how these measures have enhanced market resilience while also creating trade-offs for market dynamics, with implications for liquidity and collateral availability.
abstract_zh: 本文综合梳理了以政府债券为抵押品的回购市场中脆弱性的相关文献，重点关注促成这些市场既脆弱又稳定的特征。文献表明，那些能够实现高效流动性提供的相同特征，包括短期融资、交易商中介、广泛的抵押品再使用以及低折扣率，也可能成为压力快速传导的渠道。本综述记录了回购市场与政府债券市场之间的紧密联系，强调回购在杠杆积累中的关键作用，并可通过交易商及非银行金融中介机构（如投资公司、对冲基金和货币市场基金）将压力传导至融资、现金和衍生品市场。近期压力事件的证据展示了这些脆弱性在实践中如何显现。本综述还考察了危机后的监管改革和中央银行干预措施，识别了这些措施如何增强市场韧性，同时为市场动态带来权衡取舍，对流动性和抵押品可得性产生影响。

title: Estimation of Factors Using Higher-Order Multi-Cumulants in Weak Factor Models
title_zh: 弱因子模型中基于高阶多重累积量的因子估计
title_primary: 弱因子模型中基于高阶多重累积量的因子估计
title_secondary: Estimation of Factors Using Higher-Order Multi-Cumulants in Weak Factor Models
authors: Guanglin Huang, Wanbo Lu, Kris Boudt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When factors are weak, covariance-based factor analysis methods tend to exhibit poor performance. To address this issue in the case of non-Gaussian data, we propose a new method called Higher-order multi-cumulant Factor Analysis (HFA). HFA estimates factors and factor loadings via the eigenvalue decomposition of the product of a higher-order multi-cumulant matrix and its transpose. We derive the asymptotic properties of HFA under a weak factor model where non-Gaussianity originates solely from the latent factors, while idiosyncratic errors remain Gaussian. Simulation studies demonstrate that HFA significantly improves both factor selection and estimation when factors are weak and non-Gaussian, compared with traditional methods. Applied to the FRED-MD dataset, HFA identifies factors that improve out-of-sample forecasting performance for the S&P 500 monthly equity premium.
abstract_zh: 当因子较弱时，基于协方差分析的因子分析方法往往表现不佳。针对非高斯数据中的这一问题，我们提出了一种新方法，称为高阶多累积量因子分析（HFA）。HFA通过高阶多累积量矩阵及其转置的特征值分解来估计因子和因子载荷。我们在弱因子模型下推导了HFA的渐近性质，其中非高斯性仅源自潜在因子，而特质误差保持高斯分布。模拟研究表明，与传统方法相比，HFA在因子较弱且非高斯的情况下显著提升了因子选择与估计的效果。应用于FRED-MD数据集时，HFA识别出的因子改善了标普500月度股权溢价的样本外预测性能。

title: Relative income and global inequality: Evidence from the United Kingdom
title_zh: 相对收入与全球不平等：来自英国的证据
title_primary: 相对收入与全球不平等：来自英国的证据
title_secondary: Relative income and global inequality: Evidence from the United Kingdom
authors: Anca Balietti, Diego Marino Fages
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides a direct replication of Fehr et al. (2022), who examine whether information about individuals’ position in the global income distribution affects preferences over global inequality. Whereas the original study draws on a representative sample from Germany, we analyze a broadly representative UK sample ( N = 2116 ). UK respondents underestimate their global rank by about 2.4 deciles on average, yet randomly providing accurate rank information has no detectable effect on real-stakes donations to international anti-poverty NGOs or on policy attitudes toward global redistribution, international organizations, globalization, or immigration. The estimated average treatment effects are small, close to zero, and precisely estimated. A data-driven heterogeneity analysis reveals no sizable or systematic differences in subgroup responses. Overall, the results reinforce the evidence that correcting global income misperceptions alone is unlikely to shift preferences over global inequality in the European settings studied so far.
abstract_zh: 本文对Fehr等人（2022）的研究进行了直接复制，该研究探讨了关于个体在全球收入分配中位置的信息是否会影响其对全球不平等的偏好。原研究基于德国代表性样本，而我们则分析了一个广泛代表性的英国样本（N = 2116）。英国受访者平均低估其全球排名约2.4个十分位，但随机提供准确的排名信息对实际捐赠给国际反贫困非政府组织的行为，以及对全球再分配、国际组织、全球化或移民的政策态度，均未产生可检测的影响。估计的平均处理效应较小，接近于零，且估计精确。数据驱动的异质性分析显示，各子群体间不存在显著或系统性的差异。总体而言，研究结果进一步证实，在迄今研究的欧洲情境中，仅纠正全球收入认知偏差不太可能改变对全球不平等的偏好。

title: Sanctions and Household Welfare: Evidence From Iran
title_zh: 制裁与家庭福利：来自伊朗的证据
title_primary: 制裁与家庭福利：来自伊朗的证据
title_secondary: Sanctions and Household Welfare: Evidence From Iran
authors: Jamal Ibrahim Haidar, Seyed Mohammad Karimi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using Iranian household microdata and welfare metrics grounded in consumer theory, we show that the 2012 SWIFT sanctions inflicted unequal welfare losses. Poorer households lost 2.3–2.8 times more than wealthier ones (quartile comparison) in terms of pre‐sanctions real expenditure. Public‐sector households needed 35%–41% more compensation than private‐sector peers; manufacturing/services households needed 37%–42% more than agriculture/construction households. Financial sanctions hurt the poor most, reversing oil sanctions predictions.
abstract_zh: 利用伊朗家庭微观数据及基于消费者理论的福利度量指标，我们揭示2012年SWIFT制裁造成了不平等的福利损失。以制裁前实际支出衡量，较贫困家庭（按四分位比较）的损失是较富裕家庭的2.3至2.8倍。公共部门家庭所需补偿比私营部门同行高出35%至41%；制造业/服务业家庭所需补偿比农业/建筑业家庭高出37%至42%。金融制裁对贫困群体冲击最大，这一结果与石油制裁的预测相反。

title: DP750 `Excessive Deficits': Sense and Nonsense in the Treaty of Maastricht
title_zh: `过度赤字'：马斯特里赫特条约中的合理与荒谬
title_primary: `过度赤字'：马斯特里赫特条约中的合理与荒谬
title_secondary: DP750 `Excessive Deficits': Sense and Nonsense in the Treaty of Maastricht
authors: Willem Buiter, Nouriel Roubini, Giancarlo Corsetti
official: 官方在线 1992-12-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In this paper we evaluate internationally agreed limits on public sector debt and deficits, such as those agreed by the EC countries in the Treaty of Maastricht as preconditions for membership in a monetary union. These fiscal convergence criteria require that general government budget deficits should not exceed 3% of GDP and that the gross debt of the general government should not be above 60% of GDP. The Maastricht requirements, especially the debt criterion, are much more stringent than those required to ensure public sector solvency. Their implementation would require an excessive degree of fiscal retrenchment which would adversely affect the level of economic activity. The deficit guideline does not appear to be sensible, since the numerical criterion refers to the nominal interest payments-inclusive financial deficit, with no corrections for inflation and real output growth, no cyclical adjustment and no appropriate allowance for future revenue-producing public sector investment. The verbal qualifications are too vague to neutralize the potential for serious damage attached to the numerical guidelines. We discuss the various `externality' arguments in favour of binding fiscal rules and find them wanting, both theoretically and empirically. An argument in favour of external enforcement of binding fiscal rules might be made in the presence of `excessive deficits' due to political distortions. We conclude that the fiscal convergence criteria should be disregarded or applied quite loosely in order to avoid the risk of serious fiscal overkill.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了国际社会对公共部门债务与赤字设定的限制性标准，例如欧盟国家在《马斯特里赫特条约》中作为货币联盟成员资格前提条件所达成的协议。这些财政趋同标准要求：一般政府预算赤字不得超过GDP的3%，一般政府总债务不得超过GDP的60%。《马斯特里赫特条约》的要求，尤其是债务标准，远高于确保公共部门偿付能力所需的水平。实施这些标准将要求过度的财政紧缩，从而对经济活动水平产生不利影响。赤字指导原则似乎并不合理，因为该数值标准针对的是包含名义利息支付的财政赤字，既未对通胀和实际产出增长进行调整，也未进行周期性调整，更未对未来能产生收入的公共部门投资给予适当考量。其文字性限定条件过于模糊，无法抵消数值指导原则可能造成的严重损害。我们探讨了支持具有约束力财政规则的各种“外部性”论点，发现这些论点在理论和实证层面均存在不足。在因政治扭曲导致“过度赤字”的情况下，或许可以提出支持外部强制实施约束性财政规则的理由。我们的结论是：为避免严重财政过度紧缩的风险，应忽略或宽松适用这些财政趋同标准。

title: Relocation and Educational Attainment: Evidence From China's Poverty Alleviation Programme
title_zh: 搬迁与教育成就：来自中国扶贫项目的证据
title_primary: 搬迁与教育成就：来自中国扶贫项目的证据
title_secondary: Relocation and Educational Attainment: Evidence From China's Poverty Alleviation Programme
authors: Junqiao Hong, Zelin Qiu, Xiaorui Qu, Yao Tang
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As a core component of human capital, education plays a pivotal role in shaping labour productivity. In remote and impoverished rural areas, limited access to post‐compulsory education creates a self‐perpetuating cycle of low education, low productivity, and entrenched poverty. Using data from China's Poverty Alleviation Through Relocation programme, this study examines the impact of relocation on children's post‐compulsory education, measured by high school enrolment. Employing a two‐way fixed effects model, we find that relocation increases the probability of high school enrolment by approximately 8.6 percentage points, with results robust to household controls and propensity score matching. Mechanism analysis provides suggestive evidence that these gains are associated with improved school accessibility, higher household income and increased educational investment. The effects are heterogeneous: educational gains are concentrated among male children and those in households with lower‐educated and older heads, are primarily driven by rural relocation, and increase with the duration since resettlement. The findings highlight both the potential and uneven distribution of human capital gains from relocation policies, providing important insights for targeted post‐relocation educational support in other developing country contexts.
abstract_zh: 作为人力资本的核心组成部分，教育在塑造劳动生产率方面发挥着关键作用。在偏远贫困的农村地区，义务教育后教育机会的匮乏形成了低教育水平、低生产率与根深蒂固贫困的自我循环。本研究利用中国易地扶贫搬迁项目数据，以高中入学率为衡量指标，考察搬迁对儿童义务教育后教育的影响。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现搬迁使高中入学概率提升约8.6个百分点，该结果在加入家庭层面控制变量及倾向得分匹配后依然稳健。机制分析表明，这些教育收益与学校可达性改善、家庭收入提高及教育投资增加存在关联。异质性分析显示：教育收益集中于男性儿童、户主受教育程度较低及年龄较大的家庭；主要源于农村搬迁驱动；且随安置时间延长而递增。研究结果揭示了搬迁政策在人力资本积累方面的潜力与分配不均问题，为其他发展中国家制定针对性的搬迁后教育支持政策提供了重要启示。

title: Monopoly Power and the Firm's Valuation: A Dynamic Analysis of Short versus Long-Term Policies
title_zh: 垄断势力与企业估值：短期与长期政策的动态分析
title_primary: 垄断势力与企业估值：短期与长期政策的动态分析
title_secondary: Monopoly Power and the Firm's Valuation: A Dynamic Analysis of Short versus Long-Term Policies
authors: Suleyman Basak, A. Pavlova
official: 聚合元数据日期 2000-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Summary.Recent anti-trust cases exacerbated the concerns of investors regarding the effects of a firm’s monopoly power on its production choice, shareholder value, and the overall economy. We address this issue within a dynamic equilibrium model featuring a large monopolistic firm whose actions not only affect the price of its output, but also effectively influence the valuation of its stock. The latter renders time-inconsistency to the firm’s dynamic production choice. When the firm is required to pre-commit to its strategy, the ensuing equilibrium is largely in line with the predictions of the textbook monopoly model. When the firm behaves in a time-consistent manner, however, the predictions are strikingly at odds. The trade-off between current profits and the valuation of future profits induces the firm to increase production beyond the competitive benchmark and cut prices. This policy may result in destroying shareholder value, and does indeed fully wipe out the firm’s profit in the limit of the decision-making interval shrinking to zero, in line with the Coase conjecture.
abstract_zh: 摘要。近期反垄断案件加剧了投资者对企业垄断势力在生产选择、股东价值及整体经济层面影响的担忧。本文通过构建一个包含大型垄断企业的动态均衡模型来探讨该问题——该企业的行为不仅影响其产出价格，还会实质性地影响其股票估值。后者导致企业动态生产选择出现时间不一致性。当企业被要求预先承诺其策略时，由此产生的均衡基本符合教科书垄断模型的预测。然而，当企业以时间一致的方式行事时，预测结果则截然不同。当前利润与未来利润估值之间的权衡促使企业将产量提升至竞争性基准水平以上并降低价格。这种策略可能导致股东价值受损，并且在决策间隔趋近于零的极限情况下，确实会完全消除企业利润——这一结论与科斯猜想相吻合。

title: Rationing by Race
title_zh: 按种族配给

authors: Singh, Manasvini, Venkataramani, Atheendar
official: 来源期次 2026-09-01 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a highstakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time-stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black, but not White, patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在高风险场景——医疗保健中——导致基于种族的配给。利用涵盖某大型医疗系统107,000例住院患者的详细时间戳数据，我们发现当医院达到容量上限时，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则未出现此现象。这些发现无法通过患者选择的差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给机制，并记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情较轻的白人患者等待更长时间。对非结构化临床记录的文本分析揭示了医护人员努力程度的配给是另一机制。

title: Capital Flows and the Global Collateral Cycle
title_zh: 资本流动与全球抵押品周期

official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Cross-country disparities in collateral technologies alone can account for large capital flows among mature economies, and allow the most advanced country to run a permanent trade deficit. When the collateral technology advantage is in creating negative beta (super safe) financial assets backed by positive beta assets, a Global Collateral Cycle emerges, with pro-cyclical gross and net flows and increased global asset price volatility. The supply of super safe assets is necessarily curtailed in downturns, providing a complementary (supply) channel to the flight to safety (demand) channel for explaining why US safe asset prices rise during crises.
abstract_zh: 仅凭抵押品技术的跨国差异，就能解释成熟经济体之间大规模资本流动的原因，并使最先进的国家能够维持永久性贸易逆差。当抵押品技术优势体现在以正贝塔资产为支撑、创造负贝塔（超级安全）金融资产时，全球抵押品周期便会形成，伴随顺周期的总流量与净流量，以及全球资产价格波动性的加剧。在经济下行期，超级安全资产的供给必然收缩，这为解释为何美国安全资产价格在危机期间上涨提供了与"避险"（需求）渠道互补的（供给）渠道。

title: Non-compete and related clauses in Canada
title_zh: 加拿大竞业禁止及相关条款
title_primary: 加拿大竞业禁止及相关条款
title_secondary: Non-compete and related clauses in Canada
authors: Dan Andrews & Andrea Garnero & Sara Holttinen
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the prevalence and potential effects of non-compete and related clauses in Canada using OECD surveys of workers and firms. It finds that these clauses are widespread, increasingly used, and often applied beyond roles where they are most justified. Many appear overly broad and legally weak, yet a substantial share of workers report having been prevented from changing jobs or starting a business. Their impact is reinforced by behavioural factors, including reputational and ethical concerns. The findings also bring into closer focus the use of (firm-to-firm) no-poaching and wage fixing agreements that restrict labour market competition and, thus, raise broader concerns for the Canadian Competition Bureau.
abstract_zh: 本文利用经合组织（OECD）对劳动者和企业的调查，为加拿大竞业限制及相关条款的普遍性及其潜在影响提供了新证据。研究发现，这些条款广泛存在、使用日益频繁，且常被应用于最缺乏合理性的岗位。许多条款过于宽泛且法律效力薄弱，但仍有相当比例的劳动者表示，这些条款阻碍了其更换工作或创业。其影响因声誉和道德关切等行为因素而进一步强化。研究结果还更聚焦于（企业间）互不挖角协议和薪资固定协议的使用，这些协议限制了劳动力市场竞争，从而引发了加拿大竞争局的更广泛担忧。

title: Rethinking release rules for international grain reserves under production risk
title_zh: 生产风险下国际粮食储备释放规则的再思考
title_primary: 生产风险下国际粮食储备释放规则的再思考
title_secondary: Rethinking release rules for international grain reserves under production risk
authors: Tetsuji Tanaka
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study develops a global stochastic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to evaluate trigger mechanisms and coverage rates for an international joint grain reserve among China, Japan, and South Korea. Framing the reserve as a cooperative risk-sharing institution with public-good characteristics, it links release-rule design to incentive compatibility and institutional sustainability. Unlike prior studies emphasizing reserve size and contribution rules, we examine how release triggers interact with probabilistic shock distributions. We compare VaR-based triggers at 70–95% confidence levels with uniform thresholds of 2.5–20% under 500 correlated productivity-shock paths. Results show that VaR-based triggers generate consistent welfare gains, risk reduction, and complete Pareto improvements. Uniform triggers produce more asymmetric outcomes; at the 10% threshold, Japan and South Korea benefit while China incurs welfare losses. For VaR designs, the optimal coverage rate is approximately 75%, since increasing coverage to 100% brings only marginal additional gains. Excessively aggressive trigger–coverage combinations can weaken performance by accelerating reserve depletion under extreme shocks. Overall, an 80% VaR trigger with 75–100% coverage provides the strongest stabilization effect and more balanced welfare distribution, supporting voluntary participation and long-term cooperation
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个全球随机可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，以评估中日韩三国国际联合粮食储备的触发机制与覆盖率。通过将粮食储备界定为具有公共品属性的合作型风险分担制度，本研究将释放规则设计与激励相容性及制度可持续性相关联。与以往侧重储备规模与出资规则的研究不同，我们重点考察释放触发机制如何与概率性冲击分布相互作用。在500条关联生产率冲击路径下，我们比较了置信水平70%-95%的VaR触发机制与2.5%-20%的统一阈值触发机制。结果表明：VaR触发机制能产生持续福利改善、风险降低及完全帕累托改进；统一阈值触发机制则呈现更显著的非对称效应——在10%阈值下，日韩两国获益而中国遭受福利损失。就VaR设计而言，最优覆盖率约为75%，因将覆盖率提升至100%仅带来边际增益。过度激进的触发-覆盖率组合可能因极端冲击下加速储备消耗而削弱绩效。总体而言，80% VaR触发机制配合75%-100%覆盖率能实现最强稳定效应与更均衡的福利分配，从而支撑自愿参与与长期合作。

title: Forecasting territorially differentiated land-use transitions: Behavioural evidence from discrete choice experiments and diffusion modelling in Southern Italy
title_zh: 预测地域差异化的土地利用转型：来自意大利南部离散选择实验与扩散模型的行为证据
title_primary: 预测地域差异化的土地利用转型：来自意大利南部离散选择实验与扩散模型的行为证据
title_secondary: Forecasting territorially differentiated land-use transitions: Behavioural evidence from discrete choice experiments and diffusion modelling in Southern Italy
authors: Ruggiero Sardaro, Piermichele La Sala
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In contexts characterized by agricultural specialization and environmental pressures, varietal choices are not simply agronomic decisions, but shape land management and the transformation of rural landscapes. Therefore, the study aims to assess producers’ attitudes toward the use of local varieties and to forecast their rate of diffusion over space and time. This allows an analysis of the temporal dynamics associated with land-use transitions. The research analyses the case of Apulia, i.e. Italy’s second-largest region in terms of vineyard area, through a combined approach. On the one hand, discrete choice experiments investigate the attitudes of producers towards landraces for sparkling wine production. On the other, the Bass diffusion model predicts the temporal trend of adoption and distinguishes between innovators and imitators. The Discrete Choice Experiments (DCE) results identify four types of producers with different preferences and Willingness To Accept (WTA) levels, which range from 2500 € ha−1 to 11,400 € ha−1. The Bass model highlights a prevalence of the imitation effect (q = 11.7%) over the innovation effect (p = 2.3%). The adoption curve is characterized by slow initial penetration, acceleration after the tenth year and territorially differentiated diffusion by the thirtieth year (24% of farms). However, the trajectories are rapid in intermediate areas and slow or incomplete in intensive or marginal areas. These trajectories suggest territorially calibrated and time-sensitive land-use policies for land-use transitions, i.e. agricultural zoning and land banks for marginal areas, support for districts and cooperatives in intermediate areas, diversification incentives and supply chain contracts for intensive areas.
abstract_zh: 在农业专业化与环境压力并存的背景下，品种选择不仅是农艺决策，更塑造了土地管理方式及乡村景观的转型。因此，本研究旨在评估生产者对地方品种使用的态度，并预测其在空间与时间上的扩散速率，从而分析土地利用转型相关的时间动态。研究以意大利葡萄园面积第二大地区——普利亚大区为案例，采用综合方法展开分析。一方面，通过离散选择实验考察生产者对用于起泡酒生产的地方品种的态度；另一方面，运用巴斯扩散模型预测采用的时间趋势，并区分创新者与模仿者。离散选择实验（DCE）结果识别出四类偏好及接受意愿（WTA）水平各异的生产者，其接受意愿介于每公顷2500欧元至11400欧元之间。巴斯模型显示模仿效应（q = 11.7%）显著高于创新效应（p = 2.3%）。采用曲线呈现初期渗透缓慢、第十年后加速增长，并在第三十年实现地域差异化扩散（覆盖24%的农场）的特征。然而，扩散轨迹在中间区域较为迅速，在集约化或边缘区域则缓慢或不完整。这些轨迹表明，土地利用转型需要在地域上精准校准且对时间敏感的政策，即针对边缘区域实施农业分区和土地银行，针对中间区域支持产区联盟和合作社，针对集约化区域提供多元化激励和供应链合同。

abstract: I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业市场势力与工人议价能力如何影响工资与福利。基于法国微观数据，我记录了现有模型无法解释的工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式。一个涵盖企业生产垂直差异化产品并与工人分享利润的模型能够解释这些模式。该模型：（i）揭示了估算买方垄断势力与议价能力面临的新挑战，并提出替代性方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导效应取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成率如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化论证了增强工人议价能力对工资与福利的影响。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）

title_zh: 拉丁美洲生育率转变的队列视角
title_primary: 拉丁美洲生育率转变的队列视角

authors: Regina Calles, Tom Vogl
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Latin America's momentous fertility transition is now in the domain of history, allowing a cohort perspective on the decline of completed fertility. Using census microdata from 17 Latin American countries, we track female birth cohorts from the 1920s to the 1970s by subnational region to document the extent to which cohort fertility decline coincided with other demographic and socioeconomic processes. Across cohorts within subnational regions, children ever born fell one-for-one with mortality decline. Expansions in urbanization, multigenerational living, women's and husbands' education, women's employment, and the non-agricultural sector all predicted declines in ever-born and surviving fertility, but women's education and sectoral composition were the dominant forces after covariate adjustment. Fertility decline was not systematically linked with improvements in children's outcomes, including school enrollment, literacy, primary completion, and non-employment. These cohort facts challenge theories of fertility decline centered on women's work and children's education but support others emphasizing women's education.
abstract_zh: 拉丁美洲意义深远的生育率转型已成为历史，这使得从队列视角审视终身生育率的下降成为可能。利用17个拉美国家的人口普查微观数据，我们追踪了1920年代至1970年代女性出生队列在次国家区域层面的变化，以揭示队列生育率下降与其他人口及社会经济进程的关联程度。在次国家区域内的队列间，终身生育数与死亡率下降呈一对一关系。城市化扩展、多代同堂居住、女性及配偶教育水平提升、女性就业增长以及非农业部门扩张均能预测终身生育数与存活子女数的下降，但在协变量调整后，女性教育水平与部门结构成为主导因素。生育率下降与儿童教育成果（包括入学率、识字率、小学毕业率及非就业率）的改善并无系统性关联。这些队列事实对以女性劳动参与和儿童教育为核心的生育率下降理论提出挑战，但支持了强调女性教育作用的其他理论。

abstract: This paper uses neoclassical monetary demand theory to measure the welfare cost of inflation. It uses the microeconomic‐ and aggregation‐theoretic approach to the demand for money, that integrates the demand for money with the demands for consumption and leisure, and provides a comparison between the consumer surplus approach based on Marshallian demand functions and the compensating variation approach based on Hicksian demand functions. The paper also reports new estimates of the welfare cost of inflation based on Hicksian money demand functions and the compensating variation approach.
abstract_zh: 本文运用新古典货币需求理论来衡量通货膨胀的福利成本。采用基于微观经济学与加总理论的方法研究货币需求，将货币需求与消费及闲暇需求相结合，并比较了基于马歇尔需求函数的消费者剩余方法与基于希克斯需求函数的补偿变差方法。文章还基于希克斯货币需求函数和补偿变差方法，报告了通货膨胀福利成本的新估计值。

title: Behavioural and social factors in farm-level agent-based models for European agricultural policy evaluations
title_zh: 欧洲农业政策评估中农场层面基于主体模型的行为与社会因素
title_primary: 欧洲农业政策评估中农场层面基于主体模型的行为与社会因素
title_secondary: Behavioural and social factors in farm-level agent-based models for European agricultural policy evaluations
authors: Robert Huber, Jesús Barreiro-Hurlé, Robert Finger
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agent-based models are valuable tools for agricultural policy evaluation. They can represent the heterogeneity of farmers and farmer interactions and are especially useful when behavioural and social factors are integrated to represent farmers’ decision-making. We assess the potential of agent-based models by conducting a review of forty-eight agent-based models developed for European agriculture and a survey with twenty-six modellers and twenty-four policy stakeholders. We find that while agent-based models provide nuanced representations of farmers’ decision-making processes, there is a gap between what is currently implemented in models, what modellers consider important and what policymakers expect.
abstract_zh: 基于智能体的模型是农业政策评估的重要工具。这类模型能够刻画农户的异质性及其互动关系，尤其在整合行为与社会因素以表征农户决策过程时具有独特价值。我们通过梳理48个针对欧洲农业开发的智能体模型，并对26位建模者及24位政策利益相关方开展问卷调查，评估了此类模型的潜力。研究发现：尽管智能体模型能细致呈现农户决策过程，但当前模型的实际应用、建模者认为重要的要素与政策制定者的预期之间仍存在显著差距。

title: Temporary acceleration or long-term change? Experimental evidence on female empowerment and intimate partner violence in urban Liberia
title_zh: 暂时加速还是长期变革？利比里亚城市地区女性赋权与亲密伴侣暴力的实验证据
title_primary: 暂时加速还是长期变革？利比里亚城市地区女性赋权与亲密伴侣暴力的实验证据
title_secondary: Temporary acceleration or long-term change? Experimental evidence on female empowerment and intimate partner violence in urban Liberia
authors: David Sungho Park
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper evaluates a multifaceted female empowerment program in urban Liberia that combined intensive psychosocial therapy with vocational skills training over 12 months. The evaluation uses a randomized controlled trial with follow-up surveys at 1 year and 3.5 years post-program (2 and 4.5 years after enrollment). At the first endline, treatment women experienced large reductions in emotional and physical/sexual intimate partner violence (IPV) and in perceived community norms supporting IPV; effects on psychological well-being were null. By 3.5 years, the treatment group’s IPV levels remained close to their first-endline values, but the treatment–control difference had closed because the control group also experienced substantial reductions. Only the gap in perceived community norms persisted. Qualitative evidence points to the psychosocial component as the primary active ingredient, while the economic arm was operationally compromised by the non-delivery of promised capital grants. We interpret the longer-term convergence as durable individual- and interpersonal-level change for treatment women, set against contemporaneous structural interventions in the study region that plausibly affected the control group in particular.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了利比里亚城市地区一项多维度女性赋权项目，该项目在12个月内将强化心理社会治疗与职业技能培训相结合。评估采用随机对照试验设计，并在项目结束后1年及3.5年（即入组后2年及4.5年）进行跟踪调查。在首次终期调查中，接受干预的女性在情感及身体/性亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）方面显著减少，且其对支持IPV的社区规范的感知也有所下降；但心理幸福感方面的效果不显著。至3.5年时，干预组的IPV水平仍接近首次终期调查时的数值，但由于对照组也经历了大幅下降，干预组与对照组之间的差异已消失。仅在对社区规范的感知差距上得以持续。质性证据表明，心理社会干预是主要有效成分，而经济干预因承诺的资本赠款未予发放而在操作上受到损害。我们将长期趋同解释为干预组女性在个体及人际层面发生的持久变化，而同期研究区域内影响对照组的结构性干预措施可能尤为相关。

title: Why Do People Protest? A Theory of Emotions, Public Policy, and Political Unrest
title_zh: 人们为何抗议？情绪、公共政策与政治动荡的理论
title_primary: 人们为何抗议？情绪、公共政策与政治动荡的理论
title_secondary: Why Do People Protest? A Theory of Emotions, Public Policy, and Political Unrest
authors: César Martinelli, Ruolong Xiao
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We build a model of policymaking under the threat of unrest. A policymaker chooses how much effort to spend on a public good; effort is unobservable and the outcome conditional on effort is uncertain. A group of citizens protest if the outcome falls short of a reference point; the reference point is determined endogenously by expectations about the outcome and by the intensity of emotions. We show that the effects of stronger emotional reactions on policymaker’s effort and the probability of protest are nonmonotonic and depend on the group’s ability to inflict damage. Equilibrium may require the policymaker to randomize between providing some effort or no effort at all, in order to temper citizens’ expectations, in which case strong emotional reactions are counterproductive. Optimal emotional reactions are fine-tuned to minimize the probability of protest.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在骚乱威胁下的政策制定模型。政策制定者需决定投入多少精力用于公共品供给；其努力程度不可观测，且努力所对应的结果具有不确定性。当公共品供给结果低于某个参照点时，公民群体便会发起抗议；该参照点由对结果的预期及情绪强度内生决定。研究表明，情绪反应的增强对政策制定者努力程度及抗议概率的影响呈非单调性，且取决于群体造成损害的能力。均衡状态下，政策制定者可能需要在"付出一定努力"与"完全不努力"之间进行随机化选择，以调节公民预期——此时强烈的情绪反应反而适得其反。最优情绪反应需精准调校，以最小化抗议发生的概率。

title: Bank Competition Amid Digital Disruption: Implications for Financial Inclusion
title_zh: 数字冲击下的银行竞争：对金融包容性的影响
title_primary: 数字冲击下的银行竞争：对金融包容性的影响
title_secondary: Bank Competition Amid Digital Disruption: Implications for Financial Inclusion
authors: ERICA XUEWEI JIANG, GLORIA YANG YU, JINYUAN ZHANG
official: 官方在线 2026-05-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how digital disruption affects bank competition using the staggered rollout of 3G mobile networks. 3G expansion increased mobile banking adoption among tech‐savvy households, reducing branch networks—especially in younger counties. Banks' strategies diverged: Less branch‐reliant banks closed branches and competed on price, while more branch‐reliant banks maintained branches but raised spreads. A structural model shows that perceived digital service improvements among younger consumers drove these shifts, reducing welfare for older savers. Counterfactuals demonstrate that subsidizing adoption for older savers can cost‐effectively reduce these disparities, facilitating a smoother digital transition.
abstract_zh: 本文利用3G移动网络的分阶段推广，考察数字冲击如何影响银行竞争。3G网络的扩展提升了精通技术的家庭对移动银行的采用率，导致银行分支网络收缩——尤其在人口较年轻的县。银行策略出现分化：对分支依赖度较低的银行关闭网点并展开价格竞争，而对分支依赖度较高的银行则维持网点但提高利差。结构模型表明，年轻消费者对数字服务感知的改善驱动了这些变化，但降低了老年储户的福利。反事实分析显示，为老年储户提供采用补贴可低成本缩小此类差距，从而推动更平稳的数字转型。

title: Unsettled: job insecurity reduces homeownership
title_zh: 不稳定的：工作不安全感降低住房拥有率
title_primary: 不稳定的：工作不安全感降低住房拥有率
title_secondary: Unsettled: job insecurity reduces homeownership
authors: Anthony Lepinteur, Andrew E. Clark, Conchita D'Ambrosio
official: 官方在线 2026-04-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the link between job insecurity and one of the most important decisions that individuals take: homeownership. The 1999 rise in the French Delalande tax on firms that laid off older workers produced an unexpected exogenous rise in job insecurity for younger workers. A difference-in-differences analysis of panel data from the European Community Household Panel shows that this greater job insecurity significantly reduced the probability of becoming a homeowner. This drop seems more attributable to individual preferences rather than greater capital constraints, consistent with individuals reducing their exposure to long-term financial commitments in more uncertain environments.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了工作不安全感与个人最重要的决策之一——购房之间的联系。1999年法国对解雇老年工人的企业征收的德拉朗德税上调，意外地外生地增加了年轻工人的工作不安全感。基于欧洲共同体住户面板数据的双重差分分析显示，这种更高的工作不安全感显著降低了成为房主的概率。这一下降似乎更多归因于个人偏好，而非更大的资本约束，这与个人在更不确定的环境中减少长期财务承诺暴露的倾向相一致。

title: The digital literacy dilemma: how information overload and negative media amplify economic gloom
title_zh: 数字素养困境：信息过载与负面媒体如何加剧经济悲观情绪
title_primary: 数字素养困境：信息过载与负面媒体如何加剧经济悲观情绪
title_secondary: The digital literacy dilemma: how information overload and negative media amplify economic gloom
authors: Hongjiao Liu, Junkai Wang
official: 官方在线 2025-09-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Against the policy backdrop of Digital China and the national campaign to enhance digital literacy and skills, this paper uses nationally representative 2019 China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) data to examine the impact of digital literacy on individuals’ economic expectations. We employ an ordered logistic regression and conduct robustness checks (alternative estimators, variable/sample substitutions, and instrumental variables). Empirical analysis reveals a counterintuitive ‘capability paradox’: individuals with higher digital literacy display more pessimistic expectations. Mechanism analysis shows that increased attention to financial and economic information is the key mediating channel. We further propose that two dimensions of the information ecosystem moderate this path: information overload (raising cognitive load and decision fatigue) and a negative media environment (activating negativity bias), which together amplify the effect of heightened information attention on pessimism. Financial literacy exhibits a similar paradox. These findings challenge the traditional digital empowerment narrative and suggest a coordinated policy response that pairs literacy promotion with proactive governance of the information environment to help stabilize expectations.
abstract_zh: 在数字中国建设与全民数字素养与技能提升行动的政策背景下，本文利用具有全国代表性的2019年中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）数据，考察数字素养对个体经济预期的影响。我们采用有序逻辑回归模型，并进行稳健性检验（包括替代估计方法、变量与样本替换以及工具变量法）。实证分析揭示了一个反直觉的“能力悖论”：数字素养越高的个体，其经济预期反而越悲观。机制分析表明，对财经信息关注度的提升是关键的中介渠道。我们进一步提出，信息生态系统的两个维度对这一路径具有调节作用：信息过载（提高认知负荷与决策疲劳）和负面媒体环境（激活消极偏差），二者共同放大了信息关注度提升对悲观预期的促进效应。金融素养同样表现出类似的悖论。上述发现对传统的数字赋能叙事构成挑战，并提示应采取协同政策应对，将素养提升与信息环境的主动治理相结合，以助力稳定预期。

title: Fighting for resources: a unified growth model of the
title_zh: 为资源而战：一个统一增长模型
title_primary: 为资源而战：一个统一增长模型
title_secondary: Fighting for resources: a unified growth model of the
authors: Tanguy Le Fur, Etienne Wasmer
official: 官方在线 2025-08-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper interprets the Great Divergence as the cumulative influence of small asymmetries in technology or various initial conditions, amplified through conflict over resources. It introduces a tractable framework that integrates demography, technological progress, and conflict into a unified growth model. The amplification effect of resource appropriation is characterized by conflict multipliers in both the short- and long-run. Conflict is a source of substantial divergence, as the appropriation of resources allows some countries to develop faster at the expense of others. Reconvergence is, however, possible through population growth, due to strategic complementarities in fertility decisions and staggered demographic transitions. Rich and non-linear dynamics display key features of comparative economic development between the West and the Global South, but also shed light on a variety of historical case studies that share such dynamics of divergence and reconvergence, as well as more dramatic episodes of population extinction in a dominated country. Our framework can easily be extended to study the role of resource exhaustion or the fundamental trade-off between trade and conflict.
abstract_zh: 本文将大分流解释为技术或初始条件中微小不对称性通过资源冲突放大后的累积影响。我们构建了一个可处理的框架，将人口学、技术进步与冲突整合为统一增长模型。资源侵占的放大效应通过短期与长期冲突乘数得以刻画。冲突是导致显著分流的根源——部分国家通过侵占他国资源实现更快发展。然而，由于生育决策中的战略互补性与交错人口转型，人口增长可能推动重新趋同。丰富的非线性动态既展现了西方与全球南方比较经济发展的关键特征，也揭示了共享这种分流与趋同动态的多种历史案例，以及被支配国家中更为剧烈的人口灭绝事件。本框架可便捷扩展至资源枯竭作用或贸易与冲突间根本权衡的研究。

title: Does environmental regulation of export destinations affect export quality? Evidence from an emerging economy
title_zh: 出口目的地的环境规制是否影响出口质量？来自新兴经济体的证据
title_primary: 出口目的地的环境规制是否影响出口质量？来自新兴经济体的证据
title_secondary: Does environmental regulation of export destinations affect export quality? Evidence from an emerging economy
authors: Weiwei Xu, Hongjun Xie, Jinxin Ren
official: 官方在线 2025-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the nonlinear impact of environmental regulations in export destinations on the export quality of Chinese manufacturing goods using the CEPII-BACI database (2001–2021). This study reveals that environmental regulations in destination countries have an inverted U-shaped effect on the quality of Chinese manufacturing exports through the combined effects of the innovation effects, crowding-out effects, and constraint effects. In addition, the scale of imported intermediate products and foreign direct investments into China have a moderating role on the inverted U-shaped relationship, shifting the inflection point of the curve to the left and flattening it. This study deepens the understanding of the spillover effects of cross-border environmental policies and their effects on export quality.
abstract_zh: 本文利用CEPII-BACI数据库（2001-2021年），考察了出口目的地环境规制对中国制造业出口质量的非线性影响。研究发现，目的地国家的环境规制通过创新效应、挤出效应和约束效应的共同作用，对中国制造业出口质量产生倒U型影响。此外，进口中间品规模与外商对华直接投资对上述倒U型关系具有调节作用，使曲线拐点左移且曲线趋于平缓。本研究深化了对跨境环境政策溢出效应及其对出口质量影响的理解。
